english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a human mother.
This is the all-purpose spoken word for one's mother.

examples.english: Mother cooked my favorite dish today.
examples.traditional: 媽媽今日煮咗我最鍾意食嘅菜。
examples.jyutping: maa1 maa1 gam1 jat6 zyu2 zo2 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 ge3 coi3

examples.english: Mom, are you coming to pick me up after school today?
examples.traditional: 媽媽，今日放學你嚟唔嚟接我呀？
examples.jyutping: maa1 maa1 gam1 jat6 fong3 hok6 nei5 lai4 m4 lai4 zip3 ngo5 aa3
